import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Split at the zero divider column. Mark cells where both panels contain
    # their respective foreground colors (7 on the left, 5 on the right).
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == 7 and right[r][c] == 5 else 9
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
